references.text: Moses goes up to God, and the Lord calls to him from the mountain and gives him instructions to convey to the people of Israel. The same formula is used: The Lord spoke to Moses.
The Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai. An identical introductory formula marking the beginning of divine revelation.
The Lord called to Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting. A standard introduction to divine instructions in Leviticus.
The Lord spoke to Moses, saying. The same literary formula that introduces laws and regulations.
The Lord said to Moses. An identical opening formula introducing holiness laws for the priests.
The Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai. The same formula that introduces the Sabbath year and Jubilee year regulations.
The Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai. A standard formula for divine communication to Moses.
The Lord spoke to Moses, saying. An identical introduction marking new divine commands.
